##### Project general facts

Vibe by Arsenal East is a contemporary residential development of two elegant towers that form a modern architectural silhouette. Strict facade geometry is complemented by wide panoramic windows, large glass surfaces and a rhythmic structure that gives the buildings a stylish, expressive presence. Each tower rises above a ground floor and two podium levels to eight residential floors, offering studios and one-bedroom apartments designed for professionals, couples and investors seeking a central city address.

Residents enjoy an indoor swimming pool and a terrace pool with a pool lounge, a fully equipped gym and a yoga and meditation area for a balanced routine. A library, a cinema, co-working spaces and modern meeting rooms support those working from home, while a terrace garden, a children's play area, a barbecue zone, jogging paths and lounge areas create welcoming social spaces, supported by concierge services, security and a multi-level car park.

Interiors convey an atmosphere of creative self-expression, with rich tones, contrasting textures and thoughtful lighting that create warm, characterful living spaces. Efficient layouts make the most of every square foot, while large windows bring natural light deep into each home. Homes are delivered fully furnished, offering a ready-to-move-in solution for owner-occupiers and a turnkey option for investors seeking strong short-stay and long-term rental demand.

##### Location description and benefits

Jumeirah Garden City is a central residential district between Al Satwa and Sheikh Zayed Road, combining modern apartment buildings with the long-established neighbourhoods of Al Satwa and Al Wasl. Local markets, cafes, restaurants, supermarkets and clinics give the area a lively, authentic character, while City Walk and the Jumeirah beachfront are close by for leisure and dining.

Sheikh Zayed Road, Al Wasl Road and Al Satwa Road connect residents with the wider city, and several metro stations are within easy reach. Downtown Dubai, Dubai Design District, the Dubai International Financial Centre and Dubai Opera are a short drive away, while Dubai International Airport, Business Bay and Jumeirah Beach are within comfortable driving distance.

Jumeirah Garden City is a freehold area open to international buyers and one of the few central locations in Dubai offering accessible entry prices. Proximity to the main business districts, metro access and a vibrant urban setting attract young professionals and short-stay guests, supporting high occupancy. Furnished studios and one-bedroom homes underpin attractive rental yields and long-term value for investors.
